mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 73 degrees by Badger Ridge Middle School. If you are out later, keep in mind the moon is a waxing crescent, and the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 7:36 PM. It will rise in the west over Mount Horeb and travel toward the northeast over the Madison area near Home Depot, climbing halfway up the sky for a 5-minute appearance.
In local news, there are no new important emails to report at this time. We are keeping a close watch on city updates as they become available.

There is plenty happening in our community. Today, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the lineup includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Regarding our local Culver's, please be aware the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel and is not serving the flavor of the day.
